held_source_feasibility.variant_seal: Can score anonymized selection-locked GSE289173 variant-gene features once. It remains a mandatory secondary retrieval comparator, never a primary signed-effect model.
held_source_feasibility.graph_seal_status: No current graph source is sealed, so graph retrieval cannot earn a champion.

known_biases_and_leakage_routes: Scoring only gene pairs present in a held eQTL, MPRA, CROP-seq, or evidence source and thereby leaking its assay coverage or positives.
Using a held-source lead variant, credible set, locus boundary, gene, transcript, expression level, eQTL beta, or interaction label to choose the coordinate or candidate roster.
Selecting canonical transcripts, GENCODE releases, protein-coding filters, distance radius, gene symbols, tie rules, or liftover behavior after outcome inspection.
Querying Ensembl, UCSC, NCBI, HGNC, disease databases, expression atlases, or online annotations after the development TSS artifact is frozen.
Splitting LD-linked variants, one locus, exact or reverse-complement sequence groups, or variant-gene derivatives across roles.
Treating ambiguous liftover, missing annotation, non-analysis contigs, REF mismatch, or unresolved gene IDs as a large distance instead of untestable.
Using proximity as an allele effect, signed eQTL or interaction-eQTL prediction, cell-type effect, or causal-gene assertion.
Counting variants, genes, transcripts, TSSs, or candidate pairs as independent biological replicates.

confounding_disposition.candidate_count: Report the exact candidate denominator per locus; a smaller outcome-derived denominator can inflate retrieval.
confounding_disposition.gene_density: Report performance by local TSS density and nearest-distance strata.
confounding_disposition.ld_block: Bootstrap and compare at LD/locus blocks, not variant-gene rows. Multiple linked anchors cannot supply independent evidence.
confounding_disposition.observability: Held-source gene and assay observability is evaluator-only and cannot define candidates or ties.

license_disposition.annotation: GENCODE official data-access page states project data are open access

remaining_blockers: Create and hash the development-built GENCODE v49 transcript-TSS artifact from the admitted 73bbbb... GTF, with primary analysis contigs, gene-version crosswalk, both-strand fixtures, duplicate handling, rejection counts, and no online lookups.
Freeze the source-independent variant-gene and locus-gene candidate contract, including any generation radius, variant roster, gene universe, row hashes, and evaluator-only eligibility.

Implement normalized VCF anchor, native-build retention, unique one-to-one liftover, REF match, TSS distance, locus minimum, equal ties, and explicit untestable states under a frozen project revision.

Prove plus- and minus-strand TSS coordinates, insertion and deletion anchors, contig boundaries, PAR and duplicate gene IDs, version stripping, equal-distance ties, ambiguous lift rejection, and candidate-order invariance.
Demonstrate that REF and ALT scores are identical and reject any attempt to populate signed eQTL, interaction-eQTL, allelic-direction, lineage, or primary endpoint fields.
For graph use, remove every held-source-selected variant, gene, candidate, locus boundary, and observability field before distance aggregation.
Freeze input annotation, candidate rows, coordinates, LD and locus groups, distance outputs, ties, and PredictionBundle hashes before sealed variant inference.
Keep graph results development-only and nearest-gene results restricted to unsigned retrieval and link comparison.
